as_told.title: 1992 CE-5 group near Pensacola sees four craft

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and activist, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1990s four craft from beings not from Earth suddenly appeared in the air near Pensacola, a city in Florida. In one telling he places it in 1992 on a beach, with a group of about 60 people gathered for a weekend to try to make contact. Greer says that after this, all kinds of insiders started coming to him, because to him it showed contact could be invited on purpose.
